channels.title: Channels
channels.emptyHint: A channel is created by your teacher or your center
channels.membersDerived: Members come from the class roster and update automatically
channels.announcementOnly: Announcements only — the teacher and their team can post
channels.readOnly: Only the teacher and their team can post here

team.title: My team
team.subtitle: Assistants are the primary contact point for your students and parents — you step in on escalations only.
team.emptyHint: Create assistant accounts so students and parents have a first line of contact.
team.name: Name
team.createFailed: Could not create the assistant account
team.removeDescription: {name} will lose team access. Existing conversations are kept, but they can no longer be contacted by your students.
team.inviteNote: The assistant sets their own password from an emailed invite link — you never see it.

claim.invalidTitle: This link is no longer valid
claim.invalidBody: The link may have expired or been used already. Ask the center to resend your registration message.
claim.credentialsBody: Set an email and password so you can sign in next time.
claim.staffBody: Choose a password for your account. Only you will know it.

centerStaff.title: Staff
centerStaff.subtitle: Create staff accounts with preset roles. Staff act on behalf of your center — every action is logged, and no one can touch the wallet, pricing, settings, or other staff.
centerStaff.emptyHint: Add receptionists, managers, or a center accountant to run your front desk and back office.
centerStaff.name: Name
centerStaff.deactivateDescription: {name} will lose access on their next request. You can reactivate them later.
centerStaff.activateDescription: {name} will regain access with their assigned role.
centerStaff.excluded: Never allowed for any staff: wallet withdrawals, pricing & revenue split, center settings, and managing staff — those stay with you.
centerStaff.auditNote: Every staff action is recorded on behalf of your center.

roleDesc.receptionist: Counter check-in, walk-in registration, cash wallet top-ups, and student lookup.
roleDesc.manager: Everything a receptionist can do, plus room management, collaboration requests, and operational reports.
roleDesc.center_accountant: Read-only view of this center's financial reports and ledger. No changes.

centerStaff.inviteNote: The staff member sets their own password from an emailed invite link — you never see it.
centerStaff.resendBody: Send {name} a fresh invite link. The previous link stops working immediately.
centerStaff.noMessagingTitle: No messaging in this role — by design
centerStaff.noMessagingBody: An accountant reads the center's books, not its families, so there is no empty inbox here to begin with. If you need to reach a teacher or a parent, ask your center manager.

oversight.title: My children's conversations
oversight.subtitle: You can view your child's conversations with teachers, assistants and center staff. This is read-only — you cannot reply, and your child is told that you can see these.
oversight.adultChild: This student is a verified adult, so their conversations are private.
oversight.readOnlyNotice: Read-only view. Opening this does not mark anything as read for your child.

invite.emailNotSent: The invite email could not be sent — share this link directly.
invite.emailNoRecipient: No email address to send to — share this link directly.
invite.linkHint: This link works once and expires. Sharing it again after it is used will not work.

guardian.title: A guardian email is required
guardian.overdueTitle: A guardian email is still required
guardian.body: Because this student is under 18, a parent or guardian email must be on file. It is where account and safety notices are sent.
guardian.locked: Until it is added, messaging with teachers and center staff is turned off. Classes, materials, grades and payments are not affected.
guardian.phoneOnFile: We have a guardian phone on file ({phone}) but no email yet.
guardian.saved: Guardian email saved — messaging is now available.
guardian.saveFailed: Could not save the guardian email
guardian.verifyPendingBody: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Your guardian needs to press it so we know the address really reaches them.
guardian.verifyFailed: Could not send the confirmation link
guardian.verifyNoop: Confirming changes nothing about your account today — it is a safety step that protects students who are minors.

security.sessionsDesc: Every device currently signed in to your account. Sign out any device you don't recognize.
security.revokeFailed: Could not sign out the device

security.scanQr: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy…), then enter the 6-digit code to confirm.
security.backupCodesDesc: Store these codes somewhere safe. Each one can be used once if you lose access to your authenticator app.
security.totpSubtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app
security.passwordDesc: Change your password. You will be signed out of every device — this one included — and sign in again with the new one.
security.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match
security.passwordChanged: Password changed — please sign in again
security.passwordRules: At least 8 characters, including a letter and a digit.
security.noPasswordSet: This account has no password yet — use your invite link to set one.

externalTeachers.title: Off-system teachers
externalTeachers.subtitle: Teachers who work at the center without a platform account. The center keeps their students, attendance, grades and money by hand — and all of it appears in the center's reports alongside everyone else.
externalTeachers.empty_body: If a teacher refuses to use the platform or keeps their own system, add them here and keep their students and accounts yourself.
externalTeachers.form_hint: This teacher will have no account and no login. You will record their groups, students, attendance and payments.
externalTeachers.form_emailHint: Optional for now — required only if they decide to join the platform later.
externalTeachers.form_centerShareHint: Hall rent or the center's flat cut of each lesson. Leave empty if it is not agreed yet.
externalTeachers.form_nationalIdHint: 14 digits. Used so the same child is never registered twice.
externalTeachers.student_reused: We already had this student — they were linked to the teacher instead of being duplicated.
externalTeachers.match_onRoster: {name} is already on this center's roster.
externalTeachers.match_elsewhere: A student with these details ({name}) is already on the platform — they will be linked, not duplicated.
externalTeachers.settle_hint: This teacher is owed {amount}. Enter what you actually handed over.
externalTeachers.settle_confirmTitle: Confirm handing this amount to the teacher?
externalTeachers.awaitingCompletion: {count} lesson(s) have happened but were never completed — the teacher is not credited for them until they are.
externalTeachers.legacySplitNote: {count} older lesson(s) have no per-lesson split record, so the share figures above exclude them. The “Owed” balance does not.
externalTeachers.convert_hint: All of their records ({records} in total) stay exactly where they are, on the same account — nothing is lost. We will email them an invite to set their own password.
externalTeachers.convert_emailHint: Needed so we can send the invite.
externalTeachers.convert_done: Converted and the invite was sent. If the email does not arrive, hand them this link:
externalTeachers.students_empty: No students for this teacher yet
externalTeachers.students_emptyHint: Register their students here so you can record attendance and payments.
externalTeachers.gaps_summary: {count, plural, one {# thing is missing and is holding up money or attendance.} other {# things are missing and are holding up money or attendance.}}
externalTeachers.gaps_cleanHint: Every lesson has attendance and is completed, and every enrolled student has paid.
